title: Kamailio v1.4.5 Released
html:
Kamailio v1.4.5 is out – a minor release of the branch 1.4, including fixes since v1.4.4 – configuration file and database compatibility is preserved…

A new release in 1.4 series is out. Kamailio 1.4.5 is based on the latest version of branch 1.4, including many fixes in code and documentation, therefore those running 1.4.0, 1.4.1, 1.4.2, 1.4.3 or 1.4.4 are advised to upgrade.

Note that latest stable version of the project is Kamailio 3.0.0, released on Janaury 11, 2010. 1.4.5 is provided to mark the end of official support for 1.4 branch by development team. It is highly recommended to upgrade to latest stable release to benefit of most actual fixes and features. More details about 3.0.0 at:

https://www.kamailio.org/mos/view/Kamailio-OpenSER-v3.0.0-Release-Notes

Kamailio 1.4.5 is a patch fix release for those still running 1.4.x version. Source tarballs are available at:

https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/1.4.5/src/

Detailed changelog:

https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/1.4.4/ChangeLog

Download via SVN:

svn co https://openser.svn.sourceforge.net/svnroot/openser/branches/1.4 kamailio

Tag for this release can be browsed at:

http://openser.svn.sourceforge.net/viewvc/openser/tags/1.4.5/

Project site at SourceForge.net (still using old name):

http://sourceforge.net/projects/openser/

Modules’ documentation:

https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/1.4.x/

What is new in 1.4.x release series is summarized in the announcement of v1.4.0:

https://www.kamailio.org/mos/view/KAMAILIO-v1.4.0-Released

Note: Kamailio is the new name of OpenSER project. First version under Kamailio name was 1.4.0. Older versions will continue to use OpenSER name.
